traceability.notes: The configurable pattern feature for valid-annotation-format is fully implemented: the rule now supports nested and flat pattern/example options for story paths and requirement IDs, validates regex configuration, falls back to default behavior when patterns are invalid or absent, surfaces configuration errors via a dedicated message, uses configured examples in error text, and integrates cleanly alongside the existing valid-story-reference rule. Tests specifically reference Story 010.1 and verify configurable behavior, precedence rules, fallback behavior, and example-driven error messages. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md provides clear examples for both nested and flat configuration forms using storyPathPattern, requirementIdPattern, storyPathExample, and requirementIdExample. Based on concrete code and test evidence, this story is fully satisfied.
